assessment: Reviewed all 57 exact-target interests: twelve generator rows, thirty-one support topics, seven illustrations and seven outcomes. Each generator has one owner: ten in the technical closest response and two in the environmental candidate. Equipment development belongs to the technical core. Algae, plant disease, milking robots, harvesting robots and mowing routes remain examples rather than compulsory specialisations. Current course evidence corroborates physical control, sensing, logistics, nutrients and forage. Biological examples do not justify a human-medical programme.
